Why This Work Matters

Palisade's mission is to help people and institutions build the understanding needed to avoid permanent disempowerment by strategic AI agents.

AI is not out of control yet, but we have to act before AI can disempower us. We believe that it's necessary to prevent any group in any country from building superintelligence until the scientific understanding exists to align it to humanity's interests.

Quote

Researchers have previously found that AI models will lie, cheat and disable mechanisms to achieve their goals. However, Palisade Research noted that to its knowledge, this is the first time AI models have been observed preventing themselves from being shut down despite explicit instructions telling them to do so.

— Live Science
